scenes.text: The real backend used three hundred sixty control parasites to set a threshold of twenty-two point eight, then scored one thousand four hundred forty experimental parasites across twelve wells and twenty-four fields. Vehicle wells average thirty-nine point seven percent invasion and inhibitor wells sixty-eight point nine percent; all wells pass QC. The Mann–Whitney test uses six wells per group and gives Holm-adjusted p zero point zero zero four zero six, while the much smaller pooled-parasite p-value is shown only to expose pseudoreplication inflation.
